Mumbai Police Prohibit Photos of Floating Durga Idols During Immersion

Mumbai Police have prohibited the circulation of photographs and videos of Durga idols that are half-submerged or floating during immersion ceremonies. The ban, which aims to prevent actions that could outrage religious sentiments, applies to the period of idol immersion. The specific details of the ban were reported by National Herald and Deccan Herald.
